$comment: Evidence ledger of attack surfaces against the schema + canonical hash layer, as demonstrated or reasoned by this harness. Each entry carries its own CURRENT status against the pinned SUT (diagnostic @ 602eac43, 2026-09-20): OPEN (risk stands), PARTIALLY REMEDIATED (named residue only), or HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (remediated; retained for audit trail — it is NOT an open risk against the pinned SUT). Status is per-entry; nothing here is implied globally.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): NFC key-collision produced duplicate-key canonical JSON
attack_surfaces.detail: The pre-freeze canonicalizer emitted '{"é":1,"é":2}' for an object holding both the NFC and NFD spelling of one key. CLOSED: the pinned SUT rejects non-NFC keys per IPC-JSON-1 R3/R8 (C-05-05 PASS; S-KEYNFC PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): -0 silently canonicalized to 0
attack_surfaces.detail: The pre-freeze implementation mapped -0 -> 0 against the frozen spec text, giving 0/-0 hash ambiguity. CLOSED: -0 is rejected at canonicalization (C-01-07 PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): schema admitted values the canonicalizer rejects
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: z.number().int() accepted 2^53 and the U64-as-string regex accepted 2^64 while canonicalization/hashing rejected them (schema-valid but unsealable objects). CLOSED: unsafe ints are rejected at schema parse and the U64 regex is upper-bounded (C-10-03, C-13-07b PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): timestamp format was shape-checked, not calendrically validated
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: '2026-13-45T99:99:99.999Z' passed TimestampSchema. CLOSED: timestamps are calendrically validated (C-13-05 PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): no canonical decimal form
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: '1.0' / '1.00' / '1' / '-0' were distinct canonical strings for one economic value. CLOSED: canonical Decimal V1 minimal form is frozen and enforced at parse (S-DEC PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: Duplicate-key raw JSON collapses last-wins before canonicalization
attack_surfaces.detail: '{"a":1,"a":2}' and '{"a":2}' hash identically. Byte-level audit of evidence text diverges from hash-level identity; a malicious producer can include decoy keys that vanish in the hash.

attack_surfaces.title: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED: id uniqueness (criteria/constraints enforced; bundle_id reuse is S1 ledger scope)
attack_surfaces.detail: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED in SUT @ 602eac43 (diagnostic run 2026-09-20): criterion_id / constraint_id uniqueness is now enforced at parse (S-UNIQ PASS). Still open: the same bundle_id sealing two different artifact sets (C-12-07) — an append-only ledger constraint, S1 scope.

attack_surfaces.title: Cross-object references are free-floating (referential existence unenforced)
attack_surfaces.detail: Decisions bind fabricated intent_hash/evidence_root and bundles bind nonexistent runs: nothing in the schema layer enforces the §15.1 north-star chain (Receipt -> Settlement -> Decision -> Bundle -> Run -> Intent) — Commander-ruled DEFERRED to S1. The settlement leg is CLOSED against the pinned SUT: settlement is receipt-gated (outcome_receipt_hash required; decision_id / proof_binding unrepresentable — S-GATE-AUTH PASS, C-14-04 asserts the rejection). proof_binding construction is sound; its INPUTS are unauthenticated at this layer pending S1.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): SEALED bundle state did not imply a correct merkle_root
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: a SEALED bundle with a fabricated merkle_root parsed; detection was left to every consumer. CLOSED: merkle_root must equal the recomputed root at schema parse (S-MERKLE PASS; C-09-02 PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: Domain/version separation relies on 0x00 exclusion, not length prefixing
attack_surfaces.detail: hash_input = domain||0x00||version||0x00||canonical is injective only because (a) domain/version literals are frozen and 0x00-free and (b) canonical JSON escapes control characters. Any future domain string containing U+0000, or a non-JSON-escaping canonicalizer, breaks the separation. A length-prefixed design would not depend on both invariants.

attack_surfaces.title: Unicode strategy diverges from RFC 8785/JCS while claiming compatibility
attack_surfaces.detail: RESOLVED IN SPEC: the canonical profile is now formally named IPC-JSON-1 (OQ-1) and intentionally diverges from raw RFC 8785/JCS: string VALUES are NFC-normalized, KEYS must already be NFC, and lone surrogates are rejected. Residual hazard: this divergence is deliberate, so a strict JCS implementation still produces different bytes — cross-implementation consumers must implement IPC-JSON-1, not JCS. U+2028/U+2029 remain raw (valid JSON, JS-source-illegal).

attack_surfaces.title: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED: 8-object G1 trust chain delivered + SHA-pinned capture; remaining objects/state machines are S1+
attack_surfaces.detail: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED in SUT @ 602eac43 (diagnostic run 2026-09-20): the delivered surface is now the 8-object G1 trust chain frozen in TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (IntentContract, Criterion, Milestone, EvidenceArtifact, EvidenceBundle, VerificationDecision, OutcomeReceipt, SettlementInstruction), verified by the exact-wire blockers S-MS-WIRE/S-RCPT-WIRE (PASS). The drift vector is CLOSED: every capture is SHA-pinned from the git object database (mode=git-sha). Still outside delivered scope: Plan/ExecutionRun/CapabilityGrant/ContributionEdge/DisputeCase and the §7 state machines (S1+).

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): SubjectRef charset included '@'
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze uncoordinated widening let user:alice@evil parse as a principal. CLOSED: '@' is rejected on every principal slot (S-SUBJ PASS; C-13-02c executable PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: Escrow bounding and nonce monotonicity absent from every delivered layer (S1 scope)
attack_surfaces.detail: Residual risk, grounded by C-15-07 (settlement lifecycle engine undelivered, S1 scope): outputs are not bounded by any escrow notion and the u64 nonce has no monotonicity — both live in the LOCKED->ELIGIBLE->RELEASED settlement machinery that does not exist yet. The former economic-format gaps ARE enforced at parse against the pinned SUT (exact-sum equality, single-asset, scale<=decimals: S-SUM / S-ASSET / S-SCALE PASS) and settlement is receipt-gated (S-GATE-AUTH PASS); the double-spend key derivation is frozen and three-way verified (C-11-07 PASS — remediation evidence, deliberately NOT cited as risk support per Commander order).

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): proof_binding did not bind milestone_id
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: the binding preimage omitted milestone_id and the API could not receive it (cross-milestone proof replay). CLOSED: frozen R9 six-field byte protocol, oracle === golden vector === SUT with sensitivity on both proof targets (S-R9 PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): settlement authorization was decision-gated
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: SettlementInstructionV1 REQUIRED decision_id + proof_binding and had no outcome_receipt_hash slot, so a raw verifier assertion could drive settlement. CLOSED: the frozen receipt-gated wire is delivered (outcome_receipt_hash required; decision_id/proof_binding unrepresentable — S-GATE-AUTH-01/02/03 and C-14-04 PASS). Retained for audit trail only.

attack_surfaces.title: HISTORICAL PRE-FREEZE FINDING (closed in SUT @ 602eac43, diagnostic 2026-09-20): settlement_key implemented the superseded preimage
attack_surfaces.detail: Pre-freeze: SHA256(proof_binding || escrow_id || 0x00 || nonce) — no domain separation, keyed on the wrong authority object. CLOSED: the frozen domain-separated receipt-keyed preimage is delivered with three-way exact agreement, TS oracle + Python KAT + SUT (S-SETTLEMENT-KEY-02, C-02-09, C-11-07 PASS). Retained for audit trail only.
